hero.text: Aone Development builds single-family homes, duplexes and small subdivisions on infill lots across Atlanta's westside and beyond. We work with investors, home buyers, landowners and lenders from lot to keys.

items.label: Investors
items.title: Put capital to work
items.text: Partner on new construction you can sell or hold for rent.

items.label: Home buyers
items.title: Buy a new build
items.text: See finished and upcoming homes ready for owners and investors.

items.label: Landowners
items.title: Hire a builder
items.text: Have a lot or a plan? We price it, permit it and build it.

items.label: Lenders
items.title: Fund a project
items.text: Draw schedules, guaranties and track record on request.

build.heading: Infill housing sized for the lots Atlanta actually has.
build.text: Narrow city lots, tight setbacks and zoning overlays are where we do our best work. Every plan is designed to rent well, sell well, or both.

items.title: Single-family homes
items.text: Ground-up homes on infill lots, from three-bedroom starter plans to multi-level homes with a private bath for every bedroom.

items.title: Duplexes & stacked units
items.text: Side-by-side and stacked duplexes, including basement units, that put two income streams on one lot.

items.title: Lot splits & small subdivisions
items.text: Turning one parcel into buildable lots, then building on them. Concept plans, civil coordination and homes.

items.title: Build-to-rent & student housing
items.text: Room-by-room layouts with private baths, designed for long-term rental demand near Atlanta's universities.

projects.heading: Current work across Atlanta.
projects.text: A selection of homes we have built, are building and are planning now. Ask us about pricing and availability.

process.heading: One team from the dirt to the closing table.
process.text: We handle each stage in-house or with partners we have built with before, so investors and owners deal with one point of contact.

steps.title: Site & numbers
steps.text: We check zoning, lot size and comps, then price the build before anyone commits.

steps.title: Plans & permits
steps.text: Our architect designs to the lot and the market. We take the plans through permitting.

steps.title: Capital & lending
steps.text: We work with private lenders and investors to put financing and a draw schedule in place.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We run construction, inspections and draws, with regular updates to owners and lenders.

steps.title: Sell or lease
steps.text: Finished homes go to a buyer or get leased up so the owner can hold and refinance.

partners.heading: Build with us.
partners.text: We are always looking for capital partners and lenders for intown new construction.

panels.title: For investors
panels.text: Own new construction without running the build. You bring capital, we bring the site, the plans and the crew.
checks: New homes and duplexes in intown neighborhoods
Exit by sale or hold as a rental and refinance
Layouts designed for strong rental demand
Regular updates from start to finish

panels.title: For lenders
panels.text: We know what a lender needs to approve a draw and close a loan, and we have the paperwork ready.
checks: Track record package available on request

contact.heading: Tell us about your project.
contact.text: Investing, buying, building or lending, we will get back to you within one business day.
